task: Surface truncated/finish_reason fields from workflow execution state API responses on two UI surfaces (execution-detail drawer and chat/thread view), updating TypeScript types, store/API layer, and conditional rendering

key_reasoning.reason: Four to six distinct components across two independent subsystems: WorkflowExecutionState type definition, workflowExecutions store (getWorkflowExecutionStateOutput), WorkflowStateOutput (drawer surface), ChatAiMessage (chat surface), and — on the chat data path — conversation.ts type and chats.ts transform; cascading compatibility impact on WorkflowExecutionEditOutputForm and ContinueWithInputPopup callers

Approximately eight files modified across four directories: src/types/entity/ (workflow.ts, conversation.ts), src/store/ (workflowExecutions.ts, chats.ts), src/pages/workflows/ (WorkflowStateOutput.tsx, plus up to two callers), src/pages/chat/ (ChatAiMessage.tsx); plus potentially one new indicator sub-component if extracted

Acceptance criteria are fully specified for both surfaces, but the chat surface has one unresolved integration question before implementation can start: whether v1/conversations/{id} already exposes truncated on each HistoryItemBackend record; Option A (extend type + transform) and Option B (secondary fetch from ChatAiMessage) diverge meaningfully in file count and architectural novelty

Drawer surface follows exact existing patterns (headerActionsTemplate injection, TooltipButton, StatusBadge); Option B for the chat surface would introduce a novel secondary-fetch pattern inside a rendering component, which has no precedent today; getWorkflowExecutionStateOutput has no store-level unit tests, so the response-mapping fix ships without a regression safety net
